### What each answer costs, named as symbols
Only the 388 remediation carries these, and no other tip in this family has them:
  emptinessOf: 3 occurrences in the 388 remediation; NOT on trunk; on the 389 line: absent
  EMPTY_NOTICES: 3 occurrences in the 388 remediation; NOT on trunk; on the 389 line: absent
  DeliveredText: 3 occurrences in the 388 remediation; NOT on trunk; on the 389 line: absent
  EmptyReason: 2 occurrences in the 388 remediation; NOT on trunk; on the 389 line: absent
So **'no-content-blocks' — the second empty-payload reason — exists nowhere but
that ref**. Revoking the 388 remediation does not just drop a duplicate wording,
it drops a capability, and any framing of this as housekeeping would be false.
Carrying it instead needs someone to resolve three real hunks in a file whose
constants, empty-payload branch and doc comment all moved underneath it — that is
writing code, which this card is forbidden to do.

### The decision requested
Choose one; neither is this card's to make:
  (a) REVOKE the 388 remediation. Accept that the 'no-content-blocks' empty
      reason is not shipped, and that trunk keeps only the zero-bytes wording
      already landed by b6e6cb73f1. Cost is named above; nothing else is lost.
  (b) CARRY it, by opening a card that replays refs/heads/fusion/stas-388-tool-result-authority onto the post-merge trunk
      and resolves the three hunks, keeping both the EMPTY_NOTICES table and the
      389 line's neutralisers. That card authors code, so it needs its own review.
This card writes nothing into STAS-387, STAS-388 or STAS-389 and creates no card.
The conflict is reported here and in the completion summary, which is where the
decision becomes visible.

## Downstream consequence to keep in view
STAS-391 depends on STAS-390 and inherits whichever empty-payload wording
survives this decision: (a) leaves it with the single ZERO_BYTES_NOTICE string,
(b) leaves it with the EMPTY_NOTICES table keyed by reason. Anything STAS-391
asserts about the wording of an empty tool result is unsettled until Leg 2 is
answered, so it should not be planned against either form before then.
